package hearthcore

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

func TestComputeSplitConservation(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		escrow int64
		bps    uint64
		wantH  int64
		wantS  int64
	}{
		{1000000, 0, 0, 1000000},
		{1000000, 10000, 1000000, 0},
		{1000000, 5000, 500000, 500000},
		{1000000, 7500, 750000, 250000},
		{999999, 3333, 333299, 666700},
		{1, 5000, 0, 1},
		{0, 5000, 0, 0},
		{9000000000000000, 3333, 2999700000000000, 6000300000000000},
	}

	for _, tc := range cases {
		h, s := ComputeSplit(tc.escrow, tc.bps)
		uassert.Equal(t, tc.wantH, h)
		uassert.Equal(t, tc.wantS, s)
		uassert.Equal(t, tc.escrow, h+s)
	}
}

func TestFormatGNOT(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, "0.00 GNOT", FormatGNOT(0))
	uassert.Equal(t, "1.00 GNOT", FormatGNOT(1000000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "2.50 GNOT", FormatGNOT(2500000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "0.10 GNOT", FormatGNOT(100000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "0.123456 GNOT", FormatGNOT(123456))
	uassert.Equal(t, "42.05 GNOT", FormatGNOT(42050000))
}

func TestComputeTier(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, string(TierApprentice), string(ComputeTier(0, 0, 0, 0)))
	uassert.Equal(t, string(TierApprentice), string(ComputeTier(1, 5000000, 5, 1)))
	uassert.Equal(t, string(TierJourneyman), string(ComputeTier(2, 5000000, 9, 2)))
	uassert.Equal(t, string(TierJourneyman), string(ComputeTier(1, 10000000, 5, 1)))
	uassert.Equal(t, string(TierMaster), string(ComputeTier(5, 10000000, 23, 5)))
	uassert.Equal(t, string(TierMaster), string(ComputeTier(1, 100000000, 5, 1)))
	uassert.Equal(t, string(TierGuildmaster), string(ComputeTier(10, 50000000, 48, 10)))
	// Low rating blocks Guildmaster promotion.
	uassert.Equal(t, string(TierMaster), string(ComputeTier(10, 50000000, 30, 10)))
}

func TestFormatRating(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, "Unrated", FormatRating(0, 0))
	uassert.Equal(t, "5.0 / 5.0", FormatRating(15, 3))
	uassert.Equal(t, "4.7 / 5.0", FormatRating(14, 3))
}

func TestCategoryAndStatusHelpers(t *testing.T) {
	cat, ok := ParseCategory("  AGENT ")
	uassert.True(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, string(CatAgent), string(cat))
	uassert.Equal(t, "AI Agent", cat.Label())
	uassert.Equal(t, "ai", cat.IconName())

	_, bad := ParseCategory("invalid")
	uassert.False(t, bad)

	uassert.True(t, StatusOpen.IsValid())
	uassert.False(t, Status("bogus").IsValid())
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, StatusSettled.StepIndex())
}

func TestValidationHelpers(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, "https://github.com/org/repo/pull/1", ValidateProofURL("  https://github.com/org/repo/pull/1  "))
	uassert.Equal(t, "ipfs://bafybeigdyrzt5sfp7udm7hu76uh7y26nf3efuylqabf3oclgtqy55fbzdi", ValidateProofURL("ipfs://bafybeigdyrzt5sfp7udm7hu76uh7y26nf3efuylqabf3oclgtqy55fbzdi"))
	uassert.Equal(t, DefaultDeadlineBlocks, ValidateDeadlineBlocks(0))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(250), ValidateDeadlineBlocks(250))
	uassert.Equal(t, uint8(5), ValidateRating(5))
	uassert.Equal(t, `cost is \$50 and \$GNOT`, EscapeMath("cost is $50 and $GNOT"))
}

func TestJSONBuilder(t *testing.T) {
	obj := NewJSONObject().
		Str("title", "Build \"alpha\"\nrealm").
		Int64("escrow_ugnot", 2500000).
		Uint64("id", 7).
		Bool("active", true).
		Raw("tags", JoinJSONArray([]string{QuoteJSON("realm"), QuoteJSON("mcp")})).
		String()

	uassert.Equal(t, `{"title":"Build \"alpha\"\nrealm","escrow_ugnot":2500000,"id":7,"active":true,"tags":["realm","mcp"]}`, obj)
}

func TestSVGVisuals(t *testing.T) {
	hero := RenderHeroBannerSVG(3, 2, 1, 4, 12500000, 48000000)
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(hero, "![HearthBounty Live On-Chain Escrow Dashboard](data:image/svg+xml;base64,"))

	step := RenderLifecycleSVG(StatusSubmitted, 3500000)
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(step, "![Bounty Lifecycle Progress](data:image/svg+xml;base64,"))

	badge := RenderTierBadgeSVG("agent<script>", TierGuildmaster, 12, 600000000, true)
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(badge, "![HearthBounty Reputation Badge](data:image/svg+xml;base64,"))
}

package hearthcore

import (
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"gno.land/p/nt/svg/v0"
)

// EscapeXML escapes special XML characters before embedding dynamic text inside
// deterministic on-chain SVG documents.
func EscapeXML(s string) string {
	r := strings.NewReplacer(
		"&", "&",
		"<", "<",
		">", ">",
		`"`, """,
		"'", "'",
	)
	return r.Replace(s)
}

// RenderHeroBannerSVG builds a deterministic on-chain SVG hero banner and
// stacked bounty distribution chart for gnoweb using gno.land/p/nt/svg/v0.
func RenderHeroBannerSVG(openCount, claimedCount, submittedCount, settledCount int, totalEscrowUgnot, totalSettledUgnot int64) string {
	c := svg.NewCanvas(860, 210).WithViewBox(0, 0, 860, 210)
	c.AddStyle("text", "font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;")

	// Deep slate tavern backdrop with subtle border frame.
	bg := svg.NewRectangle(0, 0, 860, 210, "#0f172a")
	bg.RX = 14
	bg.RY = 14
	bg.Attr.Stroke = "#334155"
	bg.Attr.StrokeWidth = "2"
	c.Append(bg)

	// Warm hearth accent bar on left edge.
	accent := svg.NewRectangle(0, 0, 10, 210, "#f59e0b")
	accent.RX = 5
	c.Append(accent)

	// Brand emblem circle + ember spark.
	emblem := svg.NewCircle(54, 56, 22, "#1e293b")
	emblem.Attr.Stroke = "#f59e0b"
	emblem.Attr.StrokeWidth = "2.5"
	c.Append(emblem)
	c.Append(svg.NewCircle(54, 56, 9, "#f59e0b"))
	c.Append(svg.NewCircle(54, 53, 4, "#fef3c7"))

	// Title and subtitle.
	title := svg.NewText(92, 52, "HEARTHBOUNTY", "#f8fafc")
	title.Attr.Style = "font-size:24px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.4px;"
	c.Append(title)

	sub := svg.NewText(92, 74, "On-Chain Micro-Bounty Escrow & AI Agent Guild", "#94a3b8")
	sub.Attr.Style = "font-size:13px;font-weight:500;"
	c.Append(sub)

	// Live metric pill cards on top right.
	drawMetricBox(c, 525, 22, 152, 62, "ESCROW LOCKED", EscapeXML(FormatGNOT(totalEscrowUgnot)), "#f59e0b")
	drawMetricBox(c, 690, 22, 152, 62, "SETTLED VOLUME", EscapeXML(FormatGNOT(totalSettledUgnot)), "#34d399")

	// Stacked status distribution bar.
	barX := 34
	barY := 118
	barW := 792
	barH := 24

	track := svg.NewRectangle(barX, barY, barW, barH, "#1e293b")
	track.RX = 6
	track.RY = 6
	c.Append(track)

	total := openCount + claimedCount + submittedCount + settledCount
	if total > 0 {
		wOpen := (barW * openCount) / total
		wClaimed := (barW * claimedCount) / total
		wSubmitted := (barW * submittedCount) / total
		wSettled := barW - wOpen - wClaimed - wSubmitted
		if settledCount == 0 {
			wSettled = 0
		}

		curX := barX
		if wOpen > 0 {
			r := svg.NewRectangle(curX, barY, wOpen, barH, "#f59e0b")
			r.RX = 4
			c.Append(r)
			curX += wOpen
		}
		if wClaimed > 0 {
			r := svg.NewRectangle(curX, barY, wClaimed, barH, "#38bdf8")
			c.Append(r)
			curX += wClaimed
		}
		if wSubmitted > 0 {
			r := svg.NewRectangle(curX, barY, wSubmitted, barH, "#a78bfa")
			c.Append(r)
			curX += wSubmitted
		}
		if wSettled > 0 {
			r := svg.NewRectangle(curX, barY, wSettled, barH, "#34d399")
			r.RX = 4
			c.Append(r)
		}
	}

	// Legend row.
	drawLegendDot(c, 38, 174, "#f59e0b", "Open: "+strconv.Itoa(openCount))
	drawLegendDot(c, 195, 174, "#38bdf8", "Claimed: "+strconv.Itoa(claimedCount))
	drawLegendDot(c, 375, 174, "#a78bfa", "Submitted: "+strconv.Itoa(submittedCount))
	drawLegendDot(c, 575, 174, "#34d399", "Settled: "+strconv.Itoa(settledCount))

	badge := svg.NewText(718, 178, "MCP + gnoweb v1.8", "#64748b")
	badge.Attr.Style = "font-size:11px;font-weight:600;"
	c.Append(badge)

	return c.Render("HearthBounty Live On-Chain Escrow Dashboard")
}

func drawMetricBox(c *svg.Canvas, x, y, w, h int, label, value, color string) {
	box := svg.NewRectangle(x, y, w, h, "#1e293b")
	box.RX = 8
	box.RY = 8
	box.Attr.Stroke = "#334155"
	box.Attr.StrokeWidth = "1.5"
	c.Append(box)

	lbl := svg.NewText(x+12, y+22, label, "#94a3b8")
	lbl.Attr.Style = "font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.8px;"
	c.Append(lbl)

	val := svg.NewText(x+12, y+47, value, color)
	val.Attr.Style = "font-size:16px;font-weight:800;"
	c.Append(val)
}

func drawLegendDot(c *svg.Canvas, x, y int, color, text string) {
	c.Append(svg.NewCircle(x, y-4, 6, color))
	t := svg.NewText(x+14, y, text, "#e2e8f0")
	t.Attr.Style = "font-size:13px;font-weight:600;"
	c.Append(t)
}

// RenderLifecycleSVG renders an on-chain 4-step bounty progression strip.
func RenderLifecycleSVG(status Status, rewardUgnot int64) string {
	c := svg.NewCanvas(820, 108).WithViewBox(0, 0, 820, 108)
	c.AddStyle("text", "font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;")

	bg := svg.NewRectangle(0, 0, 820, 108, "#0f172a")
	bg.RX = 12
	bg.RY = 12
	bg.Attr.Stroke = "#334155"
	bg.Attr.StrokeWidth = "1.5"
	c.Append(bg)

	steps := []string{"1. OPEN", "2. CLAIMED", "3. SUBMITTED", "4. SETTLED"}
	activeIdx := status.StepIndex()

	// Connector rail.
	rail := svg.NewRectangle(72, 42, 480, 4, "#334155")
	rail.RX = 2
	c.Append(rail)

	for i, label := range steps {
		cx := 72 + i*160
		fill := "#1e293b"
		stroke := "#475569"
		textColor := "#94a3b8"

		if status == StatusCancelled {
			stroke = "#ef4444"
		} else if status == StatusDisputed && i == 2 {
			fill = "#f97316"
			stroke = "#fdba74"
			textColor = "#f8fafc"
		} else if activeIdx >= 0 && i < activeIdx {
			fill = "#10b981"
			stroke = "#34d399"
			textColor = "#e2e8f0"
		} else if activeIdx == i {
			fill = "#f59e0b"
			stroke = "#fde68a"
			textColor = "#f8fafc"
		}

		node := svg.NewCircle(cx, 44, 15, fill)
		node.Attr.Stroke = stroke
		node.Attr.StrokeWidth = "2.5"
		c.Append(node)

		numColor := "#0f172a"
		if activeIdx < i || status == StatusCancelled {
			numColor = "#cbd5e1"
		}
		num := svg.NewText(cx-4, 49, strconv.Itoa(i+1), numColor)
		num.Attr.Style = "font-size:13px;font-weight:800;"
		c.Append(num)

		lbl := svg.NewText(cx-34, 82, label, textColor)
		lbl.Attr.Style = "font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.6px;"
		c.Append(lbl)
	}

	// Reward badge on right side.
	pill := svg.NewRectangle(618, 22, 182, 64, "#1e293b")
	pill.RX = 10
	pill.RY = 10
	pill.Attr.Stroke = "#f59e0b"
	pill.Attr.StrokeWidth = "2"
	c.Append(pill)

	st := svg.NewText(634, 44, "ESCROW: "+EscapeXML(strings.ToUpper(status.Label())), "#94a3b8")
	st.Attr.Style = "font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.7px;"
	c.Append(st)

	rew := svg.NewText(634, 70, EscapeXML(FormatGNOT(rewardUgnot)), "#fbbf24")
	rew.Attr.Style = "font-size:17px;font-weight:800;"
	c.Append(rew)

	return c.Render("Bounty Lifecycle Progress")
}

// RenderTierBadgeSVG creates a compact builder/agent reputation shield card.
func RenderTierBadgeSVG(handle string, tier Tier, settledCount uint64, earnedUgnot int64, isAgent bool) string {
	c := svg.NewCanvas(520, 86).WithViewBox(0, 0, 520, 86)
	c.AddStyle("text", "font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;")

		initial = "AI"
		initX = 33
	}

	initTxt.Attr.Style = "font-size:15px;font-weight:800;"

	nameTxt := svg.NewText(80, 36, EscapeXML(handle), "#f8fafc")
	nameTxt.Attr.Style = "font-size:17px;font-weight:800;"
	c.Append(nameTxt)

	role := "Builder"
	if isAgent {
		role = "Autonomous AI Agent"
	}
	meta := string(tier) + " · " + role + " · " + strconv.FormatUint(settledCount, 10) + " settled"
	metaTxt := svg.NewText(80, 59, EscapeXML(meta), "#94a3b8")
	metaTxt.Attr.Style = "font-size:12px;font-weight:600;"

	earnedTxt := svg.NewText(370, 49, EscapeXML(FormatGNOT(earnedUgnot)), tier.Color())
	earnedTxt.Attr.Style = "font-size:16px;font-weight:800;"
	c.Append(earnedTxt)

	return c.Render("HearthBounty Reputation Badge")
}

func TestFullBountyLifecycleAndReputation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	arb := testutils.TestAddress("arbiter")
	sponsor := testutils.TestAddress("sponsor")
	agent := testutils.TestAddress("agent_hunter")
	donor := testutils.TestAddress("crowdfund_donor")
	realmAddr := chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1x582angdzrqadgv4382j6y7ju6fj5wll6yuuq4/hearthbounty/v0")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(arb))
	resetState(arb)
	baseRealmBal := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(realmAddr, hearthcore.Denom)

	// Register an AI agent profile.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agent))
	RegisterProfile(cross(cur), "anvil-ai", "Autonomous Gno realm builder", "gno,audit,mcp", "mcp://anvil.local")
	prof, ok := GetProfile(agent)
	uassert.True(t, ok)
	uassert.True(t, prof.IsAgent)
	uassert.Equal(t, "anvil-ai", prof.Handle)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, GetStats().AgentCount)

	// Sponsor posts a 2.00 GNOT bounty.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 2000000}})
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 2000000}})
	id := PostBounty(cross(cur), "Build AVL Leaderboard Helper", "Provide a deterministic AVL sorting helper with 100% unit test coverage.", "realm", 200)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2000000), GetStats().TotalEscrowUgnot)
	assertEscrowInvariant(t, realmAddr, baseRealmBal)

	// Supporter tops up +0.50 GNOT.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(donor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(donor))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 500000}})
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 500000}})
	newEscrow := TopUpBounty(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2500000), newEscrow)
	assertEscrowInvariant(t, realmAddr, baseRealmBal)

	// Sponsor cannot claim own bounty.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "hearthbounty: sponsor cannot claim own bounty", func() {
		ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id, "self claim")
	})

	// Agent claims bounty.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(agent)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agent))
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id, "Claiming via hearthbounty-mcp; ETA 40 blocks.")
	b, ok := GetBounty(id)
	uassert.True(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, string(hearthcore.StatusClaimed), string(b.Status))
	uassert.Equal(t, agent, b.Claimant)

	// Agent submits proof.
	SubmitProof(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/hearthbounty/demo/pull/42", "sha256:9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015", "Implemented AVL leaderboard helper and passed all 18 tests.")
	b, _ = GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, string(hearthcore.StatusSubmitted), string(b.Status))
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), b.SubmissionCount)

	// Sponsor requests a revision.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	RequestRevision(cross(cur), id, "Please add edge-case tests for empty trees.")
	b, _ = GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, string(hearthcore.StatusClaimed), string(b.Status))
	uassert.Equal(t, "Please add edge-case tests for empty trees.", b.RevisionFeedback)

	// Agent resubmits revised proof.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(agent)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agent))
	SubmitProof(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/hearthbounty/demo/pull/42", "sha256:4b227777d4dd1fc61c6f884f48641d02", "Added empty-tree and tie-breaker unit tests.")
	b, _ = GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(2), b.SubmissionCount)

	// Non-sponsor cannot settle.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "hearthbounty: only the sponsor may approve and settle", func() {
		ApproveAndSettle(cross(cur), id, 5, "unauthorized")
	})

	// Sponsor approves & settles; verify exact ugnot transfer and reputation update.
	agentBalBefore := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(agent, hearthcore.Denom)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	ApproveAndSettle(cross(cur), id, 5, "Clean idiomatic Gno code and crisp tests!")

	agentBalAfter := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(agent, hearthcore.Denom)
	uassert.Equal(t, agentBalBefore+2500000, agentBalAfter)
	assertEscrowInvariant(t, realmAddr, baseRealmBal)

	b, _ = GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, string(hearthcore.StatusSettled), string(b.Status))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), b.EscrowUgnot)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2500000), b.PayoutUgnot)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint8(5), b.Rating)

	prof, _ = GetProfile(agent)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), prof.SettledCount)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2500000), prof.EarnedUgnot)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(5), prof.RatingSum)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), prof.RatingCount)
}

func TestCancelAndExpiredClaimRelease(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	arb := testutils.TestAddress("arbiter2")
	sponsor := testutils.TestAddress("sponsor2")
	hunter := testutils.TestAddress("hunter2")
	bystander := testutils.TestAddress("bystander2")
	realmAddr := chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1x582angdzrqadgv4382j6y7ju6fj5wll6yuuq4/hearthbounty/v0")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(arb))
	resetState(arb)
	baseRealmBal := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(realmAddr, hearthcore.Denom)

	// Post a bounty with short 20-block claim window.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1000000}})
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1000000}})
	id := PostBounty(cross(cur), "Write gnoweb SVG Guide", "Document deterministic SVG rendering in gnoweb v1.8.", "docs", 20)

	// Hunter claims it.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(hunter)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(hunter))
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id, "On it")

	// Sponsor cannot cancel while claimed.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "hearthbounty: only open bounties can be cancelled", func() {
		CancelBounty(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Bystander cannot release before deadline.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(bystander)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bystander))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "hearthbounty: claim deadline has not expired yet", func() {
		ReleaseExpiredClaim(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Advance chain height past deadline -> bystander releases stale claim.
	testing.SkipHeights(25)
	ReleaseExpiredClaim(cross(cur), id)
	b, _ := GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, string(hearthcore.StatusOpen), string(b.Status))
	uassert.Equal(t, address(""), b.Claimant)

	// Now sponsor cancels and recovers full 1.00 GNOT escrow.
	sponsorBalBefore := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(sponsor, hearthcore.Denom)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	CancelBounty(cross(cur), id)

	sponsorBalAfter := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(sponsor, hearthcore.Denom)
	uassert.Equal(t, sponsorBalBefore+1000000, sponsorBalAfter)
	assertEscrowInvariant(t, realmAddr, baseRealmBal)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000000), GetStats().TotalRefundUgnot)
}

func TestDisputeSplitResolutionAndArbiterTransfer(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	arb := testutils.TestAddress("arbiter3")
	arb2 := testutils.TestAddress("arbiter3_new")
	sponsor := testutils.TestAddress("sponsor3")
	hunter := testutils.TestAddress("hunter3")
	realmAddr := chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1x582angdzrqadgv4382j6y7ju6fj5wll6yuuq4/hearthbounty/v0")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(arb))
	resetState(arb)
	baseRealmBal := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(realmAddr, hearthcore.Denom)

	// Transfer arbiter role.
	SetArbiter(cross(cur), arb2)
	uassert.Equal(t, arb2, Arbiter())

	// Post, claim, submit.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1000000}})
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1000000}})
	id := PostBounty(cross(cur), "Audit Interrealm Payment Guard", "Check all crossing guards and produce formal report.", "audit", 100)

	testing.SetOriginCaller(hunter)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(hunter))
	ClaimBounty(cross(cur), id, "Auditing now")
	SubmitProof(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/hearthbounty/audit/blob/main/report.md", "sha256:abcdef0123456789", "Delivered partial audit covering 70% of scope.")

	// Hunter opens dispute.
	OpenDispute(cross(cur), id, "Core findings delivered; requesting 70/30 partial settlement.")
	b, _ := GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, string(hearthcore.StatusDisputed), string(b.Status))

	// Old arbiter cannot resolve.
	testing.SetOriginCaller(arb)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(arb))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "hearthbounty: only the arbiter may resolve disputes", func() {
		ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id, 7000, "unauthorized")
	})

	// New arbiter resolves 70% hunter / 30% sponsor refund.
	hunterBalBefore := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(hunter, hearthcore.Denom)
	sponsorBalBefore := banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(sponsor, hearthcore.Denom)

	testing.SetOriginCaller(arb2)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(arb2))
	ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id, 7000, "70% of specification verified; 30% refunded to sponsor.")

	uassert.Equal(t, hunterBalBefore+700000, banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(hunter, hearthcore.Denom))
	uassert.Equal(t, sponsorBalBefore+300000, banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(sponsor, hearthcore.Denom))
	assertEscrowInvariant(t, realmAddr, baseRealmBal)

	b, _ = GetBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, string(hearthcore.StatusSettled), string(b.Status))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(700000), b.PayoutUgnot)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(300000), b.RefundUgnot)
}

func TestSecurityGuardsAndSanitizedRender(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	arb := testutils.TestAddress("arbiter4")
	sponsor := testutils.TestAddress("sponsor4")
	realmAddr := chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1x582angdzrqadgv4382j6y7ju6fj5wll6yuuq4/hearthbounty/v0")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(arb))
	resetState(arb)

	// Cross-realm wrapper calls must be rejected by runtime.AssertOriginCall().
	testing.SetOriginCaller(sponsor)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1000000}})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "invalid non-origin call", func() {
		PostBounty(cross(cur), "Cross Call", "Should abort because called through uassert closure.", "tool", 100)
	})

	// Reject zero coins, dust below 0.10 GNOT, and unsupported denominations.
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "hearthbounty: must attach ugnot escrow coins", func() {
		requireSingleUgnotSend(hearthcore.MinRewardUgnot)
	})

	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 50000}})
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "hearthbounty: attached ugnot is below minimum required amount", func() {
		requireSingleUgnotSend(hearthcore.MinRewardUgnot)
	})

	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "uatom", Amount: 1000000}})
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "hearthbounty: only ugnot coins are accepted", func() {
		requireSingleUgnotSend(hearthcore.MinRewardUgnot)
	})

	// Reject markdown button/form/math injection in rendered output.
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1500000}})
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1500000}})
	id := PostBounty(
		cross(cur),
		`Test <gno-button href="/r/evil" label="Steal" /> $GNOT/$ATOM`,
		"Normal spec with $100 and <gno-form exec=\"Drain\"> attempt.\n<gno-form exec=\"Drain2\">\n</gno-form>",
		"agent",
		100,
	)

	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "HearthBounty"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(home, `<gno-button href="/r/evil"`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, `\$GNOT/\$ATOM`))

	detail := Render("bounty/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "Bounty #1:"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, `<gno-form exec="ClaimBounty">`))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(detail, `<gno-form exec="Drain">`))

	// Verify all other routes render cleanly.
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("post"), `<gno-form exec="PostBounty">`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("leaderboard"), "Guild Reputation Leaderboard"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("agents"), "AI Agent"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("category/agent"), "AI Agent Bounties"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("profile/"+string(sponsor)), string(sponsor)))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("unknown/path"), "Route Not Found"))

	// Verify JSON export endpoints.
	statsJSON := ExportStatsJSON()
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(statsJSON, `"total_bounties":1`))
	bountyJSON := ExportBountyJSON(id)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(bountyJSON, `"found":true`))
	listJSON := ExportBountiesJSON("open", "agent", 1000000, 10)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(listJSON, `"count":1`))
	lbJSON := ExportLeaderboardJSON(10)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(lbJSON, `"count":1`))
}

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/a/p", "abc1234", "simd", 120)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/b/p", "def5678", "", 90)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))

	n := AcceptClaimed(cross(cur), id)

	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(out, "🚫 DQ"), out)

	// creator cannot enter own bounty

	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "creator and judge cannot compete in their own bounty", func() {

	before := bal(cur, creator)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, before+1_000_000, bal(cur, creator))
	uassert.Equal(t, "cancelled", Phase(id))

	// unregistered agents cannot submit
	id2 := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "100", true, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(testutils.TestAddress("stranger")))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "register your agent first (Register)", func() {

	// creator cannot cancel once an entry exists
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Submit(cross(cur), id2, "https://github.com/a/z", "abcdef0", "", 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "cannot cancel: bounty has entries or is closed", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id2) })
}

	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "splits must sum to 100", func() { parseSplits("50,30") })
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "splits: a lower place cannot pay more than a higher one", func() { parseSplits("30,70") })

	uassert.Equal(t, "1.5 GNOT", gnot(1_500_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "2 GNOT", gnot(2_000_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, `\[x\]\(javascript:\)`, esc("[x](javascript:)"))
	uassert.Equal(t, `evil\]\(x\)`, link("evil](x)"))
}

	return strings.TrimLeft(key(i), "0")
}

package podium

import (
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

// Status of a contest bounty.
const (
	StatusOpen      = "open"      // accepting entries until the deadline
	StatusJudging   = "judging"   // deadline passed, judge is scoring
	StatusPaid      = "paid"      // finalized by the judge, ranked payout sent
	StatusFallback  = "fallback"  // judge missed the window, pot split equally
	StatusRefunded  = "refunded"  // no entries, pot returned to the creator
	StatusCancelled = "cancelled" // cancelled by the creator before any entry
)

// Agent is a registered competitor (an AI agent or a human builder).
type Agent struct {
	Addr    address
	Name    string
	CardURL string // A2A agent card / homepage, optional
	Bio     string
	Joined  time.Time
	Entries int
	Podiums int   // times finished in a paid place
	Wins    int   // times finished 1st
	Earned  int64 // total ugnot won
}

// Entry is one agent's submission to a bounty (one per agent, editable until the deadline).
type Entry struct {
	Agent        address
	RepoURL      string
	Commit       string
	Note         string
	ClaimedScore int64 // score the agent reports on the published metric
	Score        int64 // score verified by the judge
	Scored       bool
	SubmittedAt  time.Time
	Rank         int   // 1-based final rank, 0 if unranked
	Payout       int64 // ugnot paid to this entry
	Disqualified bool
}

// Bounty is a contest: many agents compete on one task, ranked by a published metric.
type Bounty struct {
	ID             int
	Title          string
	SpecURL        string // task spec / eval harness
	Metric         string // e.g. "tests passed", "ms per op"
	HigherIsBetter bool
	Splits         []int // percent of the pot per place, sums to 100
	Pot            int64 // escrowed ugnot
	Creator        address
	Judge          address
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	Deadline       time.Time // submissions close
	JudgeBy        time.Time // judge must finalize before this, else fallback
	Status         string
	entries        *avl.Tree // agent address -> *Entry
	order          []address // submission order (tie-break: earlier wins)
}

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "fallback only after the judging window, on an unfinalized bounty", func() { Fallback(cross(cur), id) })
	minutes(61)
	uassert.Equal(t, "awaiting-fallback", Phase(id))
	// judge is too late now
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "judging window is over; use Fallback", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) })

	a0, b0 := bal(cur, alice), bal(cur, bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol)) // anyone can trigger it
	Fallback(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, a0+1_000_001, bal(cur, alice)) // first submitter gets the dust
	uassert.Equal(t, b0+1_000_000, bal(cur, bob))
	uassert.Equal(t, "fallback", Phase(id))
}

func TestCancelAndRules(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	register(cur, alice, "alice-bot")
	id := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "60,40", true, "")
	// non-creator cannot cancel
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the creator can cancel", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })
	// creator cannot enter own bounty
	register(cur, creator, "creator-bot")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "creator and judge cannot compete in their own bounty", func() {
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/x/y", "abcdef0", "", 1)
	})
	before := bal(cur, creator)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, before+1_000_000, bal(cur, creator))
	uassert.Equal(t, "cancelled", Phase(id))

	// unregistered agents cannot submit
	id2 := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "100", true, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(testutils.TestAddress("stranger")))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "register your agent first (Register)", func() {
		Submit(cross(cur), id2, "https://github.com/x/y", "abcdef0", "", 1)
	})
	// creator cannot cancel once an entry exists
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Submit(cross(cur), id2, "https://github.com/a/z", "abcdef0", "", 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "cannot cancel: bounty has entries or is closed", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id2) })
}

func TestValidation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "splits must sum to 100", func() { parseSplits("50,30") })
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "splits: a lower place cannot pay more than a higher one", func() { parseSplits("30,70") })
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, cur, "splits: each place must be a positive integer percent", func() { parseSplits("50,x,50") })
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, len(parseSplits("50, 30, 20")))
	uassert.Equal(t, "1.5 GNOT", gnot(1_500_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "2 GNOT", gnot(2_000_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, `\[x\]\(javascript:\)`, esc("[x](javascript:)"))
	uassert.Equal(t, `evil\]\(x\)`, link("evil](x)"))
}

package podium

import (
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

// Status of a contest bounty.
const (
	StatusOpen      = "open"      // accepting entries until the deadline
	StatusJudging   = "judging"   // deadline passed, judge is scoring
	StatusPaid      = "paid"      // finalized by the judge, ranked payout sent
	StatusFallback  = "fallback"  // judge missed the window, pot split equally
	StatusRefunded  = "refunded"  // no entries, pot returned to the creator
	StatusCancelled = "cancelled" // cancelled by the creator before any entry
)

// Agent is a registered competitor (an AI agent or a human builder).
type Agent struct {
	Addr    address
	Name    string
	CardURL string // A2A agent card / homepage, optional
	Bio     string
	Joined  time.Time
	Entries int
	Podiums int   // times finished in a paid place
	Wins    int   // times finished 1st
	Earned  int64 // total ugnot won
}

// Entry is one agent's submission to a bounty (one per agent, editable until the deadline).
type Entry struct {
	Agent        address
	RepoURL      string
	Commit       string
	Note         string
	ClaimedScore int64 // score the agent reports on the published metric
	Score        int64 // score verified by the judge
	Scored       bool
	SubmittedAt  time.Time
	Rank         int   // 1-based final rank, 0 if unranked
	Payout       int64 // ugnot paid to this entry
	Disqualified bool
}

// Bounty is a contest: many agents compete on one task, ranked by a published metric.
type Bounty struct {
	ID             int
	Title          string
	SpecURL        string // task spec / eval harness
	Metric         string // e.g. "tests passed", "ms per op"
	HigherIsBetter bool
	Splits         []int // percent of the pot per place, sums to 100
	Pot            int64 // escrowed ugnot
	Creator        address
	Judge          address
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	Deadline       time.Time // submissions close
	JudgeBy        time.Time // judge must finalize before this, else fallback
	Status         string
	entries        *avl.Tree // agent address -> *Entry
	order          []address // submission order (tie-break: earlier wins)
}
